security_audit.summary: The reviewed static findings are primarily false positives from Markdown code examples and JavaScript template literals. content.value_statement: Code migrations fail when teams miss dependencies, behavior changes, and rollback needs. This skill creates structured migration plans, test strategies, and validation steps.
actual_capabilities: Assesses source code structure, dependencies, complexity, and migration risks.
Builds phased migration plans with milestones, resources, and success criteria.
Provides examples for framework, language, API, and database migrations.
Defines comparison testing for functionality, performance, data, APIs, and user flows.
Creates rollback planning guidance and progress monitoring patterns.
limitations: It provides guidance and examples, not guaranteed automated conversion.
Generated scripts require review before running on real repositories.
Migration estimates depend on accurate project context from the user.
It cannot replace production testing, security review, or release approval.

use_cases.title: Framework Upgrade Planning
use_cases.description: Create a phased plan for moving an application to a newer framework version.

use_cases.title: Legacy Language Migration
use_cases.description: Identify syntax, library, and behavior changes before migrating legacy code.

use_cases.title: Release Risk Control
use_cases.description: Define tests, rollback triggers, and monitoring for a migration launch.

prompt_templates.title: Assess a Migration
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner assessment for a known source and target stack.
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess migrating my project from [source stack] to [target stack]. List risks, missing inputs, and first validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Migration Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate planning for a team preparing work phases.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a phased migration plan for [application]. Include milestones, owners, tests, rollout gates, and rollback triggers.

prompt_templates.title: Design Validation Tests
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced testing for behavior parity across versions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a comparison testing strategy for this migration. Cover functionality, data integrity, APIs, performance, and user workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Review Migration Automation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before running generated migration tooling.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this proposed migration automation for safety. Identify file changes, required permissions, dry-run steps, and rollback checks.

output_examples.input: Migrate a React class component application to Vue.
output: Migration analysis covering component patterns, lifecycle methods, state, and routing.
Phased plan with conversion order, tests, and rollback checkpoints.
Review notes for generated component transformation examples.

output_examples.input: Upgrade a Python 2 service to Python 3.
output: Inventory of syntax changes, dependency risks, and compatibility gaps.
Testing plan for runtime behavior, data handling, and service interfaces.
Release checklist with monitoring and rollback criteria.

output_examples.input: Convert REST endpoints into a GraphQL layer.
output: Mapping of resources, operations, arguments, and response types.
Resolver design guidance and network dependency notes.
Validation plan for API parity and client migration sequencing.

best_practices: Provide source stack, target stack, repository size, critical flows, and release constraints.
Run generated automation in dry-run mode before changing production code.
Define rollback triggers before starting each migration phase.
anti_patterns: Do not run generated scripts without code review and backups.
Do not migrate all components at once when phased delivery is possible.
Do not treat passing unit tests as full migration validation.

faq.question: Can this skill migrate code automatically?
faq.answer: It can draft automation and transformations, but humans must review and test them before use.

faq.question: Which migrations does it support?
faq.answer: It covers frameworks, language versions, APIs, databases, platforms, and release processes.

faq.question: Does it inspect my repository directly?
faq.answer: Only when the connected AI tool has repository access and the user requests analysis.

faq.question: How should I use the generated plan?
faq.answer: Use it as a starting point for team review, estimation, testing, and release approval.

faq.question: Can it create rollback plans?
faq.answer: Yes. It can define rollback triggers, procedures, verification steps, and communication needs.

faq.question: Is it suitable for production migrations?
faq.answer: Yes, as planning support. Production changes still need backups, tests, approvals, and monitoring.
